{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of sites and their names
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print("Unique sites:", unique_sites)

# Compute response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(3)

# Check if any site has significantly different distribution in other variables
# Cross-tabulate site vs arm to check for balance
site_arm_cross = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm'])
print("\nSite vs Arm cross-tabulation:")
print(site_arm_cross)

# Cross-tabulate site vs severity
site_severity_cross = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity'])
print("\nSite vs Severity cross-tabulation:")
print(site_severity_cross)

# Check age distribution by site
age_by_site = df.groupby('site')['age'].mean().round(1)
print("\nMean age by site:")
print(age_by_site)

# Check sex distribution by site
sex_by_site = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['sex'])
print("\nSite vs Sex cross-tabulation:")
print(sex_by_site)"}
